node.statement: The reverse triangle inequality gives abs(||u_T||-||T||)<=||u_T-T||. Combining this with abs(||T||-1)<=a*e from the first child and the second child gives abs(||u_T||-1)<=[a+k*(1+a)+2*(1+a)+1]*e. The bracket is a universal finite constant, and intersecting the existing validity threshold with e<=1 proves item (iii). This derivation uses no quantitative unit axiom for an eta-C*-algebra and thereby replaces the challenged inference.
